INSERT INTO investor_flow_analysis ( stock_code, base_date, net_ratio, score, is_double_buy, is_clean_buy, reason ) VALUES
( #{f.stockCode}, #{f.baseDate}, #{f.netRatio, jdbcType=DECIMAL}, #{f.score}, #{f.doubleBuy}, #{f.cleanBuy}, #{f.reason, jdbcType=VARCHAR} ) AS new ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE net_ratio = new.net_ratio, score = new.score, is_double_buy = new.is_double_buy, is_clean_buy = new.is_clean_buy, reason = new.reason
